name: Order Flow Delta Divergence

anti_hunt: Trailing Stop → entfernt sich vom Hunt
vulnerability: Stops an S/R Struktur → MM kennt die Levels

hypothesis: When price makes new highs/lows but cumulative delta does NOT confirm, institutional absorption is occurring and reversal is likely.
edge_rationale: Delta divergence reveals hidden institutional activity. Works best on centralized exchanges with real volume data (futures, crypto).
best_when: Trending or range-bound markets with clear volume patterns. US session 9:30-11:30 / 14:00-16:00 ET.
worst_when: Choppy/whipsaw markets, low volume, news-driven moves, forex spot (no real volume).
entry_conditions: Price makes new low + cumulative delta makes HIGHER low = bullish divergence -> buy
Price makes new high + cumulative delta makes LOWER high = bearish divergence -> sell
Confirmation: engulfing candle OR swing break
Optional: bid/ask stacking in order book
exit_tp_logic: TP at opposite swing. Trail using delta shifts. 50% at 1R, trail rest.
reported_note: ~55-65% WR, 1:1.5-1:3 R:R, PF 1.5-2.5. Professional futures traders methodology.
notes: REQUIRES real volume data (CME futures, crypto). NOT for forex spot.
